title: Higher Chern--Simons Theory in $2n+2$ Dimensions for Balanced 2-term $L_\infty$-Algebras
summary: We construct a semistrict higher Chern--Simons (HCS) gauge theory in $2n+2$ dimensions associated with balanced 2-term $L_\infty$-algebras. Starting from the homotopy Maurer--Cartan theory, we first introduce 2-term $L_\infty$-algebra gauge theory, and show that there is a four-dimensional HCS construction. Then we extend invariant bilinear pairings to invariant multilinear forms of the appropriate degree, and define a $(2n+3)$-dimensional higher Pontryagin--Chern form, which is closed and invariant under infinitesimal gauge transformations.
